key_takeaways: LLM 출력물에 무비판적으로 의존할 때 발생하는 사고의 표준화 및 획일화

en.title: Avoiding Cyborgization: Preventing LLM Tones from Becoming Your Own Thoughts
en.hook: A critical warning on how LLM-generated phrasing can unconsciously colonize and standardize human thinking.
key_takeaways: The homogenization of thought resulting from uncritical reliance on LLM outputs
Methods to preserve human critical thinking and independent voice in the AI era
Establishing a healthy relationship between LLM as a tool and human agency

zh.title: 为了不变成赛博格：防止LLM的语调成为你的思维方式
zh.hook: 警惕LLM生成的格式化文本与语调在不知不觉中同质化并侵蚀人类独立思考能力的现象。
key_takeaways: 盲目依赖LLM输出所导致的思维标准化与同质化风险
在AI时代如何保持人类独有的批判性思维与独立声音
确立作为工具的LLM与作为主体的独立思考之间的正确关系
